mapper.select: select follow_id, user_id, type, object_id, create_time from mw_follow where follow_id = #{followId} limit 1

select u.user_id, u.username, u.given_name, u.mobile, u.phone, u.email, u.department, u.position, u.location, u.im, u.last_ip, u.last_time, u.role_id, u.is_forbidden, u.is_delete, u.create_time, u.update_time, f.follow_id from mw_follow f inner join mw_user u on u.user_id = cast(f.object_id as signed) where f.user_id = #{userId} and f.type = #{type} and u.is_delete = 0 order by f.follow_id desc

select u.user_id, u.username, u.given_name, u.mobile, u.phone, u.email, u.department, u.position, u.location, u.im, u.last_ip, u.last_time, u.role_id, u.is_forbidden, u.is_delete, u.create_time, u.update_time from mw_follow f inner join mw_user u on u.user_id = f.user_id where f.object_id = #{objectId} and f.type = #{type} and u.is_delete = 0 order by f.follow_id desc

select f.follow_id, d.document_id, d.parent_id, d.space_id, d.name, d.type, d.path, d.sequence, d.create_user_id, d.edit_user_id, d.create_time, d.update_time from mw_follow f inner join mw_document d on d.document_id = f.object_id inner join mw_space s on s.space_id = d.space_id left join mw_space_user su on su.space_id = d.space_id and su.user_id = #{viewerId} where f.user_id = #{userId} and f.type = #{type} and d.is_delete = 0 and s.is_delete = 0 and (#{root} = true or s.visit_level = 'public' or su.space_user_id is not null) order by f.follow_id desc
mapper.insert: insert into mw_follow(user_id, type, object_id, create_time) values (#{userId}, #{type}, #{objectId}, #{createTime})
mapper.select: select cast(object_id as signed) from mw_follow where type = #{type} group by object_id order by count(*) desc limit 1
